culturalBackground: Astronomical winter runs from the December solstice to the March equinox; buyers plan winter campaigns months ahead.

name: World Environment Day
description: UN's June 5 flagship environmental day — annual themes drive focused campaign content.
culturalBackground: Led by UNEP since 1973; each year spotlights a theme (e.g., plastic pollution, land restoration).
commercialRelevance: NGOs and eco brands need theme-aligned nature and action visuals.

name: World Health Day
description: WHO's April 7 observance — healthcare publishers and wellness brands need medical-wellness visuals.
culturalBackground: Marks WHO founding (1948); each year has a campaign theme announced by WHO.
commercialRelevance: Healthcare, insurance and wellness buyers need clean medical illustrations and healthy-lifestyle photos.

name: World Mental Health Day
description: October 10 — wellness brands and employers spotlight mental-health conversations.
culturalBackground: WHO-backed day since 1992; annual themes guide campaign messaging.
commercialRelevance: Wellness, HR and healthcare buyers need calm, supportive mental-health visuals.

name: World Teachers' Day
description: UNESCO's October 5 observance — education publishers and schools celebrate educators.
culturalBackground: Commemorates the 1966 ILO/UNESCO recommendation on teachers' status.
commercialRelevance: Education brands need teacher-appreciation visuals and classroom illustrations.
